scope: Final accuracy, consistency, alignment and straightforwardness closeout, followed by bounded live checks only after guide fixes and offline validation.

accuracy: Each B session now fits 195 minutes of labs plus 45 minutes of breaks/buffer.
Teaching plans are not labeled as measured learner durations.
Historical foundation evidence is not called the current preset.
consistency: Core policy inspection is distinct from optional File Search in the generator, ZIPs and setup guides.
The prepared terminal is consistently A Lab 05's default.
alignment: B seeding writers, including participants, need the two named Search writer roles.
Actual saved agent versions and instructions are kept when resuming source checks.
English availability evidence is an explicitly labeled reference, not a Korean tutorial image.
straightforwardness: One default workflow path; Hosted Responses requires preselection and owner verification.
Failures stop the chosen path rather than silently changing accounts, models or learning routes.
Current evidence links and per-item status distinguish fresh, historical, blocked and design-only work.

initial_regressions: The four new checks failed for both languages before the corrections. Full validation also caught the unregistered/cross-language availability image; the original media test was preserved.
status_meaning: Executed/contract-checked means the documented command completed and its observable output contract was checked. It is not an all-case business-quality score, actual human approval, or production acceptance.
questions_source: Exact current guide CLI blocks. These are not a new dev/holdout evaluation cohort.
caller_boundary: Guide commands used the existing training subscription's explicitly pinned Azure CLI authentication. Portal checks used the already authenticated headless browser. The separate Foundry MCP read failure is retained, not counted as success.

mcp_probe.boundary: Do not relabel this as a successful MCP read. The planned guide CLI checks use the repository's explicit subscription-bound authentication; the already authenticated headless portal is checked separately.
